Message.MsgText: The properties file ''file name'' does not exist and will be ignored.
Unable to modify entry because no key value was provided.

Explanation.p: The modify entry operation in the Properties Connector failed because no key value was specified.

OperatorResponse.p: Specify a key value in the configuration of the Properties Connector.

Message.MsgText: The properties file ''file name'' for property store name was not found, and will be created if anything is written to it.

Explanation.p: The named file was not found. The Create flag was set in the configuration for this Properties Connector, so the file will be created if needed.

OperatorResponse.p: If the Create flag was erroneously set, the non-existing file may indicate a problem. Verify that the Properties Connector does not need the file to exist, and if necessary, uncheck the Create flag in the configuration.

Message.MsgText: The Certificate ''certificate name'' for property file file name was not found.

Explanation.p: The named Certificate was not found in the server keystore, or could not be used to create a Crypto Object. Therefore properties in this file cannot be decrypted.

OperatorResponse.p: Verify that the named Certificate exists in the keystore.

Message.MsgText: No Password or Property Key specified for encrypted property file file name.

Explanation.p: There was no Password or Property Key specified for the encrypted property file. Therefore properties in this file cannot be decrypted.

OperatorResponse.p: Specify a password or Property Key.
